coverage.scope: Purposive design examples, not an extraction accuracy sample or a whole-dossier re-review. References resolve to the immutable dossier; bindings do not establish historical truth.

cases.title: Whole-engagement totals
cases.interpretation: NPS prints US 65,085 and CS 44,968 for the whole engagement. These are not April 6 opening availability counts.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Keep the existing baseline unchanged. Establish opening-specific evidence for a new candidate; do not relabel the totals.

cases.title: Paper return and nested Wallace total
cases.interpretation: The 44,895 present-for-duty abstract includes Wallace's 7,564. Subtracting them would give paper arithmetic, not establish opening combatants; omissions and mixed return dates remain.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Review unit membership, detachments, omissions, date differences and boundary availability before any subtraction or whole-army transform.

cases.title: One return in multiple representations
cases.interpretation: The Sixth Division 5,463 in the p.112 summary/detail and linked facsimile represents one underlying return. Source metadata v3 corrects dependence; three representations are not three independent estimates.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Retain the shared-document relationship and missing regiments/battery; establish boundary applicability. A successful provenance check alone does not admit 5,463.

cases.title: Confederate pre-battle alternatives
cases.interpretation: The 40,335 and 38,773 effective totals differ in composition. The latter heading describes an April 3 march and includes a Monday-arrival footnote; forwarding dates do not establish muster dates. The discrepancy is not an admitted opening-force range.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Resolve comparable population and timing before declaring applicable scenarios. A later-written return can pass if its earlier referent and derivation are established; later publication alone is not disqualifying.

cases.title: After-battle returns
cases.interpretation: 29,636 is labeled after the battle; report 137 gives 32,212 with an April 10 heading. These cannot be opening predictors or be reverse-engineered with casualties. Do not assign April 7 as an exact muster date to the undated after-battle column.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Preserve both observations and discrepancies for descriptive research. A separate future outcome profile would be a new design, not opening admission.

cases.title: An estimated integer within a mixed-phase total
cases.interpretation: Reed's 735 is explicitly estimated although printed as an integer, and is included in his 7,545 reconstruction. Its estimation label is valid evidence metadata, not a reason to invent uncertainty bounds or reject all estimates. Adding 735 to 7,545 would double count.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Review 735 as its own boundary-specific candidate; rebuild any total from a complete disjoint same-boundary population, excluding later arrivals. The printed 7,545 cannot simply become opening strength.

cases.title: McCook detail versus recap
cases.interpretation: Reed prints 7,553 in detail and 7,552 in recap; the values describe April 7 participation and are explicitly estimated. Preserve the one-person discrepancy, never average to 7,552.5. Neither is an April 6 opening alternative.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: For any future April 7 descriptive profile, review scope and linked reconstruction first; do not use performance to choose a value.

cases.title: Army of the Ohio aggregate and nested components
cases.interpretation: The 17,918 recap includes Nelson 4,541, McCook 7,552, Crittenden 3,825 and Wagner 2,000. Reed's note describes mixed March/April returns; 9,118 is an April 30 McCook return. No total-plus-components sum or opening reconstruction is authorized.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Preserve the recap and note as evidence. Scenarios must keep totals/components coherent and cannot make later participation an opening input.

cases.title: Nelson and Grose differing contingents
cases.interpretation: The handbook's 600, Grose's about 400 in eight companies, Nelson's 380 for the regiment and 4,541 division action total are not interchangeable same-time populations. They cannot establish a missing exact Sunday crossing strength, much less the April 6 opening force.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Keep the exact-crossed claim null and record differing scopes. Do not infer casualties by subtraction or replace the unknown with one convenient figure.

cases.title: Document dates are not event or readiness times
cases.interpretation: Ammen's April 10 report and separately printed undated-composition diary must retain their own section dates. Crittenden reports arrival about 21:00 April 6, then debarkation as soon as practicable; that is not a 21:00 completed debarkation or readiness timestamp.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Preserve each event phase and unknown completion time. These April 6/7 reinforcement narratives cannot substitute for opening availability; document date nulls do not erase known event ordering.

cases.title: Unknown logistics stays unknown
cases.interpretation: The logistics claim is null. No numerical supply or readiness observation exists to encode, and missing is not zero or normal.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Acquire evidence and define/review a separate supply feature profile before any numerical use.

cases.title: Preparation, orders and commander credit
cases.interpretation: Halleck's issue dates do not prove receipt; NPS attribution is not adjudicated responsibility. Johnston's reported death is not Beauregard's evidenced effective command assumption. Preparations may be mediators, not controls that identify total command contribution.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Develop a separately reviewed causal estimand, replacement boundary, authority and information mapping. No equal allocation of residuals or battle/campaign addition.

cases.title: Outcome channel is separate
cases.interpretation: Recorded Union victory is an outcome label, never a pre-engagement predictor. Its separate use as a target does not approve any strength quantity.
cases.requirements_for_future_use: Bind outcome provenance in a future evaluation manifest and keep target data out of predictor derivations and source selection.
